_comment: Cost model for estimating sync-run spend. Edit the rates when model pricing changes, or tune the token estimates after checking real usage once. Everything here is an estimate. There is no per-run invoice, since scheduled tasks draw on the Claude plan rather than API billing. Treat the output as magnitude and trend, not accounting.
_token_model: Tokens for one sync run = base + (listed x per_listed) + (fetched x per_fetched) + output for each note written.
_alerts: Thresholds for the monthly report. A run that rewrites most of the archive usually means a bug, not real activity. warn_monthly_usd must stay below monthly_budget_usd, or the warning fires after the hard stop instead of before it.
_budget: Hard cap on estimated spend for the CURRENT calendar month. When month-to-date estimate reaches this, engine/budget_check.py exits 2 and the sync skill refuses to fetch. Resets automatically on the 1st. This caps an ESTIMATE, not a bill. Scheduled runs draw on the Claude plan, so crossing it does not mean money left an account. Set to 0 to disable the cap entirely.
